"That Lord Qin and Madam Qin have come calling today — even we servants understand full well......" Uncle Ning pressed on, deliberately pausing for effect before continuing, while the faces of Madam Qin and her party darkened further.

"It is Madam Qin and Lord Qin who do not wish to part ways cleanly. It is not my master who eagerly invited any of you here."

"As for opening the main gate — that is simply because our Qin household values propriety. Otherwise, the gate need not have been opened at all, and no one could have said a word against it."

"After all, none of you are honored guests who received an invitation from our Qin residence!"

"You......you wretched old slave......" The Qin Old Matriarch clutched at her chest. Qin Ruyue hurried forward to support her, then turned to glare furiously at Uncle Ning.

Yet she had just been subjected to Wang Huaimin's thinly veiled contempt, and she had no desire to openly cross swords with a servant in front of everyone.

She looked instead toward her own mother, Tong Shi.

She exchanged a meaningful glance with her, hoping Tong Shi would speak up in support of the Old Matriarch.

But Tong Shi appeared not to notice Qin Ruyue's glance. The matriarch turned toward her and drew nearer — yet Tong Shi took a step back instead.

Qin Ruyue felt a surge of bitter disappointment toward her mother.

Noting Tong Shi's movement, Qin Mingjie shot his wife a ferocious glare.

......

Uncle Ning, who had been addressed repeatedly as "wretched old slave" by the Old Matriarch, remained impassive.

He said coolly: "And what of it, being a wretched old slave? Even this wretched old slave knows more propriety than certain grand dames of wealthy and powerful households."

"As for the side gate — what of it? My master himself uses the side gate when he departs for early morning court. Why any of you should make such a fuss over it, I truly cannot fathom!"

Seeing that the crowd of onlookers gathering at a distance was growing larger by the moment, Qin Mingjie grew anxious.

"Enough! Lead this official and his family inside at once!"

Uncle Ning's lips curled in a mocking smile — making no effort whatsoever to conceal it — and called out loudly to a young manservant standing nearby: "Datou, take these guests inside. I'll go inform the master first."

"After all, my master is at present keeping company with our honored Third Son-in-Law in conversation, and I haven't yet sent anyone ahead to notify him......"

"Who could have known that the Madam and Lord Qin of the Shunyi Hutong Qin household would simply show up at our door without so much as sending a calling card first?"

The mother and son pair — the Old Matriarch and Qin Mingjie — nearly frothed with rage.

Qin Ruyue's exquisite face twisted grotesquely with fury.

Tong Shi, on the other hand, wore a more agreeable expression.

In fact, a hidden, almost secretive excitement stirred within her.

Good.

Let these two venomous creatures be vexed to death — that would be a fine thing indeed!

Because Uncle Ning had deliberately raised his voice for those last few sentences, the onlookers who hadn't dared draw too close — yet whose curiosity burned fiercely — had mostly caught every word.

The busybodies among them immediately broke into loud commentary.

"Oh my, so the Qin family from Shunyi Hutong just showed up without sending a calling card? Isn't that terribly presumptuous?"

"Isn't it? I heard the two families have already separated their clans...... If they've already split clans, surely they're less than distant relatives by now?"

"Precisely! Once they split clans, they become two entirely different Qin family lineages. Even if they were once brothers, they are legally nothing more than strangers." An elderly scholar stroked his salt-and-pepper beard and nodded.

"Goodness, even Scholar Hu says so! Then it's the Shunyi Hutong Qin family that's being unreasonable!"

"That's right. The elder master of the Zijing Hutong Qin household is the one who truly knows propriety — even his servants do. He opened the main gate to receive them, and they couldn't even be grateful for it, railing at his servants instead...... That is truly unreasonable behavior!"

"Indeed! The Shunyi Hutong Qin family is quite something — even common folk like us have heard of them...... Before the two families split clans, the elder master and his family from Zijing Hutong were harshly suppressed by the Shunyi Hutong side......"

"Tsk, tsk, tsk. So this is how the noble and powerful behave? In my eyes, they have far less propriety than us ordinary folk!"

......

The Old Matriarch was of advanced age and naturally couldn't make out what the onlookers outside were saying.

Qin Ruyue and her elder brother Qin Ronggong were young enough to hear more clearly. The siblings' faces cycled through a riot of colors, like a freshly opened dyehouse.

Qin Ronggong glared furiously at Uncle Ning's retreating back, then turned to lay the blame on the Old Matriarch: "Grandmother, what was the point of quarreling with a servant out there in public?"

"There's an old saying — the King of Hell is easier to deal with than his little demons. You hadn't even set foot inside the estate, and you were already wrangling with a servant at the front gate. He held a grudge and started shouting it all out loud......"

"And now look — those riffraff outside heard everything and are busy gossiping about everything wrong with us!"

The Old Matriarch was both furious and heartbroken. "Ronggong, you...... are you actually blaming your grandmother? Everything your grandmother does — who is it for, if not for all of you younger ones?"

Qin Ronggong turned his face away.

Qin Ruyue's eyes flickered.

She said under her breath to Qin Ronggong: "Elder brother, hold your tongue! Grandmother is right — everything she does is for us younger generations, and especially for you, elder brother! ...... If anything good comes of this today, won't the greatest share fall to you?"

Only then did Qin Ronggong's expression ease.

The entire party swallowed their pride and entered the Qin family estate. The moment they were inside, the side gate was shut behind them.

They had no way of knowing that among those bystanders outside, some had already scattered in all directions, embellishing and retelling the scene that had unfolded before the main gate of the Zijing Hutong Qin estate to anyone who would listen.

The young manservant called Datou listened to the old, the middle-aged, and the young among this family speak, and a cold, scornful smile spread across his face.

Just as the old saying goes — children of concubines rarely turn out decent.

Look at this family, three generations of them — they didn't even measure up to the old and young of a respectable ordinary household!

No wonder even his own parents had told him: better to marry a maidservant from a respectable family than the daughter of someone's concubine.

He would follow Head Steward Ning diligently and learn well!

One day, he'd ask the Head Steward to find him a wife among the maids who served the ladies of the household — now that would be a fine life!

It took Qin Mingjie and his party a full quarter of an hour's walk before they neared the front courtyard and main hall of the Qin residence.

With every step he took deeper into the estate, Qin Mingjie's expression grew darker.

The residence looked large from the outside — from the inside, it looked even larger......

He had only ever heard of this former prince's private manor through the mouths of colleagues, and had not imagined that not only was it vast in scale, but the interior was exquisitely built indeed......

It was immeasurably finer than the house he occupied in Shunyi Hutong!

......

The Old Matriarch had been well-fed and pampered through the years and was plump and pale. Combined with the fact that Qin Ruyue had fallen ill before her wedding and still hadn't fully recovered, having walked this long just to reach the main courtyard, the old woman's expression had grown even more dreadful.

What a vast courtyard!

One glance at the main courtyard's layout and scenery was enough to reveal the whole from a part.

What a magnificent courtyard!

So vast, so beautiful, so refined......

How wonderful it would be if it were hers!

It wasn't a matter of money.

The real issue was that even with money, there was no guarantee of the connections needed to acquire such a place!

Qin Mingjie's heart was bleeding with hatred.

If only he had known!

If only he had simply done away with Qin eldest when he was still young!

But in a moment of softness, he had let him grow into someone this formidable......

Now, even if he were to move against him again, who knew how much effort it would take!

"Mother, elder brother and elder sister-in-law's courtyard is truly magnificent!" Tong Shi took in the mother and son's expressions and laughed coldly within herself, deliberately needling them.

She also admired a residence this vast and fine in her heart.

Yet she would not dwell on it too long.

After all, her mother's family's ancestral estate back in Hexi was far larger than this house — it was simply not in the capital.

The Old Matriarch reacted to these words as though her tail had been stepped on.

She hissed at Tong Shi in agitation: "Everything you say is paid for by what Old First's mother left behind in her dowry! Your Tong clan is a distinguished family — your trousseau was no small thing either. If you like it so much, you're welcome to spend your own silver and buy yourself a grand mansion like this!"

Tong Shi heard her out and was not the least bit offended.

She curled her lips in a mocking smile. "Don't say such things, Old Matriarch. My dowry was nothing much — merely quite a great deal more than yours."

Hmph.

This old crone — a kept concubine her whole life, clinging to a man like a dodder vine. What dowry could she possibly have had?

"Mingjie! What a fine wife you've taken!" The Old Matriarch, unable to get the better of Tong Shi, vented her anger on Qin Mingjie instead.

Qin Mingjie turned a vicious glare on Tong Shi: "You unvirtuous, unfilial shrew — hold your tongue!"

Tong Shi struck back immediately: "If you're so virtuous and filial, why don't you go buy us a grand estate this large and fine?"

Qin Ronggong, siding with his father, reproached Tong Shi: "Mother! You are in the wrong. Look at the time — how can you still be quarreling with Grandmother?"

Tong Shi felt a chill in her heart at having produced such a son. He was a waste.

Qin Ruyue still cared about her maternal Tong family, and so she spoke up in defense of her mother.

She looked at her elder brother Qin Ronggong with displeasure and lowered her voice to reproach him: "Elder brother! At a time like this, you're still only thinking about blaming Mother. You're not worth the affection she's wasted on you!"

Qin Ronggong flew into a rage.

The family quarreled the entire way, until at last they came upon Uncle Ning again.

Uncle Ning had his hands tucked into his sleeves, wearing an expression that was almost but not quite a smile, and gave them a slight bow.

"My master has only just been informed of your visit...... My master says that even though none of you sent a calling card, guests are guests, and our Qin household cannot allow itself to fall short in matters of propriety."

"Please, all of you, follow me."

chapters.title: She Cannot Accept It — She Refuses to Submit!
chapters.content:
Uncle Ning led the Old Matriarch and her party to the main reception hall of the inner courtyard.

This was the place where the Qin family received guests.

The reason the Qin Elder Master had not received them in the side hall was that Jiang Jiuxiao had shown no inclination to step aside.

The Elder Master thought to himself — he could deny anyone comfort in this house, but certainly not his esteemed new son-in-law.

Since the son-in-law had no wish to withdraw, he would, of course, defer to the son-in-law's preference.

And so it was in the main hall that he received the Old Matriarch and her party.

"Old First......" The Old Matriarch glanced at Jiang Jiuxiao, and seeing him seated with perfect composure — serene and unmoved as an untroubled wind — she turned her displeasure onto the Elder Master instead.

She asked, feigning ignorance: "Is this the Sixth Girl's new husband, Lord Jiang? How is it that he acts as though he cannot see this old woman here?"

The Elder Master called out flatly: "Madam Qin."

Then, paying no mind to the Matriarch's darkening expression, he said with perfect composure: "My second brother and I have both separated from the clan, and therefore have nothing to do with your household."

"My Third Son-in-Law, furthermore, is a second-rank official of the court — the Minister of Personnel — and has no need to rise and greet a third-rank Honorary Lady who bears no relation to him."

The implication was plain: you are not worth his regard.

The Old Matriarch nearly spat blood on the spot.

The Elder Master finished speaking and paid her no further attention. He simply turned to look at Qin Mingjie. "Lord Qin is surely a man who understands protocol — is this not correct?"

Qin Mingjie's eyes had darkened until they could drip water.

Qin eldest had made clear from the very start that he had no intention of recognizing the two households as brothers!

Otherwise, he would not have spoken so harshly.

"Elder brother, you have now become...... so utterly ruthless that you do not even acknowledge your own ancestors?"

Qin Mingjie's words were deeply vicious.

But the Elder Master would not allow himself to be slandered as one who disowned his ancestors.

"You may refuse to acknowledge your ancestors — I still acknowledge mine." The Elder Master frowned slightly. "It simply is that you honor yours, and I honor mine. They are not the same."

The Second Master, who had been seated to the side, regarding the Old Matriarch and her son with unconcealed hatred, said coldly:

"My elder brother speaks plainly! Lord Qin, now that we and you four brothers have separated our clans, we should all take care to preserve some dignity. Stop coming here to put on these hollow shows of feeling — it is disgusting!"

"Third Qin, you! Have you completely lost your senses?" Qin Mingjie erupted in fury.

The Second Master said coldly: "Address me as Second Master Qin! I have long since ceased to be the Third Young Master of your household. Please conduct yourself with some decorum, Lord Qin!"

"This old woman is vexed to death...... vexed to death! Old Master, why did you go so soon!"

"Look at these two sons of yours — they do not recognize this old woman as their mother, do not recognize Mingjie and his brothers as their kin......"

The Old Matriarch began to wail and sob without the slightest regard for decorum — just as she had always done when the Old Master was alive.

After all, the Old Master not only did not dislike this performance of hers, but was in fact entirely susceptible to it.

He had taken it as a sign that she cared so deeply for him that she allowed herself these little tantrums in his presence.

When the Old Matriarch carried on this way, even Tong Shi gave her a wide berth.

Qin Mingjie merely furrowed his brow, then sat down in a chair and said nothing.

Qin Ronggong stood behind his father and kept his head bowed, lost in his own thoughts.

Qin Ruyue felt a ripple of embarrassment, and stole a glance at Jiang Jiuxiao.

He was dressed in the deep scarlet ceremonial robes of a second-rank official. Holding his teacup, he sat perfectly still — composed and towering as a mountain, impervious to all.

It was as though nothing could reach him. Not a brow was raised, not a single glance spared for her wailing grandmother.

And that face of his — it was truly handsome!

He was clearly eleven years her senior, yet he looked as though he were only three or four years older.

Like a god descended from the heavens......

Before her marriage to Wang Huaimin, she had thought Wang Huaimin young and dashing at only a few years her elder. But now that she had actually married him, she knew he was hollow inside — all surface and no substance.

If only Jiang Jiuxiao's disposition weren't so cold — impossible to warm no matter how one tried — she would have used the advantage of her rebirth to save him and his Jiang family, even knowing their household was on the brink of ruin.

What a pity......

"Lord Qin, you intend to allow your elderly mother to carry on like this in someone else's residence?" The Elder Master said mildly, turning to look at Qin Mingjie.

The Second Master also laughed coldly: "Madam Qin mentions missing the late Old Master so very much — why not go down and keep him company?"

This was different from the Elder Master, who merely refused to acknowledge the Old Matriarch.

He was done acknowledging even the Old Master — that muddleheaded, hypocritical, and selfish old fool.

This life of his had been pulled from the hands of this old crone by his legitimate mother.

In this lifetime, the only mothers he would ever recognize were his legitimate mother and his birth mother!

As for his father — what was that supposed to mean to him?

"Hic——" The Old Matriarch nearly choked on her own bile.

Qin Mingjie also thundered at the Second Master to stop.

The Second Master looked at him coldly. "This is my elder brother's residence, not your Shunyi Hutong Qin family's, where you reign unchallenged. Stop putting on airs here!"

Seeing her son outmaneuvered, the Old Matriarch began sobbing again, calling out that the Old Master had died too soon......

The Second Master watched her coldly. "Madam Qin, you shout for the Old Master so frequently — perhaps there is something uncanny at work of which you are unaware. In good will, allow me to share something......"

"Over the years I have traveled far and wide and heard no shortage of strange tales. One in particular: an old widow, hoping to hold her children in her grip, wailed daily that her husband had died too soon......"

"One night, that very husband truly did crawl up from beneath the earth and dragged her soul down to the underworld with him......"

"Ah!" The Old Matriarch stopped mid-cry, and swiftly snatched up her handkerchief to dab away her tears — the speed of it left even Qin Mingjie and the others struck dumb with surprise.

Only Jiang Jiuxiao remained unmoved, raising his teacup to his lips and speaking for the first time: "Second Uncle's account appears in a record of unusual tales concerning customs and traditions in the southwest."

"A subsequent investigation found...... that it can indeed be accomplished through a certain form of sorcery."

The Old Matriarch's aged eyes brimmed with terror.

She regretted deeply within herself.

From this day forward......

She would never again wail and cry out for the Old Master!

Right.

She could not...... she must even avoid mentioning him too often!

Seeing Jiang Jiuxiao finally speak, Qin Mingjie seemed to notice him for the first time and rose from his seat to bow in greeting.

"Minister Jiang......"

"Lord Qin." Jiang Jiuxiao looked at Qin Mingjie flatly, without so much as a glance at Qin Ronggong, who had bowed along with his father.

Qin Ronggong's eyes filled with sullen resentment as he stood bent in his bow — furious but powerless to speak.

After all, his rank was far beneath Jiang Jiuxiao's.

And this Jiang Jiuxiao had watched the grandmother wail for so long without uttering a single word of rebuke.

It was plain that this cousin-in-law by marriage also had no intention of acknowledging the Shunyi Hutong Qin family as relations......

Infuriating!

Qin Mingjie saw Jiang Jiuxiao simply sit there and receive his elder's bow without so much as rising — merely offering a brief return bow — and understood.

Jiang Jiuxiao had no wish to recognize him as a second uncle!

The respectable relatives the Qin family could still count on had either broken with them or grown distant. Even the Prince An's side had become remote......

He had originally hoped to let his elderly mother make a scene, forcing this new son-in-law Jiang Jiuxiao to speak up of his own accord — compelling the Elder Master to hold his nose and resume ties with them.

After all, Jiang Jiuxiao's standing was what it was.

If he took the initiative, the Elder Master, if nothing else, would not dare refuse for the sake of his youngest daughter, Sixth Miss Qin......

"Madam Qin. Lord Qin. What needed to be said, my father-in-law and Second Uncle have already made plain to you."

"You are both men who serve at court — it would be best to preserve a measure of dignity."

"Furthermore, this official must inform Madam Qin and Lord Qin: my wife holds the third position in her father's household and may properly be addressed as Third Young Lady of the Qin household."

The color drained from the faces of the Old Matriarch and Qin Mingjie.

Even Tong Shi, who had been secretly relishing the spectacle, felt a knot of discomfort in her expression.

Qin Ruyue was seized by wild, consuming jealousy.

He......

Jiang Jiuxiao was actually protecting Qin Ruyin like this?

He would not even permit the grandmother to address her as "Sixth Girl"?

He actually referred to Qin Ruyin as his wife in front of all these people?

On what grounds?

On what grounds, now that it was Qin Ruyin who had married him, did he guard her so fiercely?

Even if it was all for show, she could not accept it!

Qin Ruyue fixed a resentful gaze on Jiang Jiuxiao, her lips parting faintly.

chapters.title: Qin Ruyue Shames Herself; Ruyin Slaps Her
chapters.content:
"Lord Jiang, you are the Minister of Personnel of our great Daying Dynasty. Surely you know that our great Daying has, from time immemorial, been governed through the principle of filial piety!"

"As a second-rank official of Daying, should you not take the lead in practicing filial obedience — serving as a model for all under heaven, and never defying your elders?"

"Even if you choose not to recognize us of the Shunyi Hutong Qin family as your relations, my grandmother is, at the very least, an elder in your regard — is she not?"

Qin Ruyue's passionate, indignant questioning was, in truth, a bid to attract Jiang Jiuxiao's attention.

But unfortunately, Jiang Jiuxiao did not so much as lift an eyelid.

He had no intention of arguing with a young married woman in front of his father-in-law, his father-in-law's second uncle, or his brothers-in-law.

Jiang Jiuxiao's utter indifference cut Qin Ruyue's pride to the quick.

She bit her lip, tears threatening to spill.

"Does Lord Jiang dare not even refute a single word of what this humble woman has said?"

Qin Ruyue was not sure what spell had come over her in that moment.

A wild thought arose within her: If Jiang Jiuxiao noticed her beauty today, he would surely see her in a different light.

Thinking it over — in her past life, Jiang Jiuxiao had rarely looked at her either.

Even when she, swallowing a maiden's shame, had taken the initiative to flirt with him, he still never gave her a proper glance......

She supposed that in her past life, Jiang Jiuxiao had never known how beautiful she was.

Well then — in this life, she would make him see it!

And in this life, now that she was a married woman, she possessed even more allure than she had at the Jiang household in her previous life.

She simply refused to believe it!

That after looking at her properly, Jiang Jiuxiao could still remain unmoved!

Her own husband — outwardly the image of a refined and restrained gentleman — was not he, too, on his knees before her come nightfall......

"Lord Jiang, you won't even deign to say a word to this humble woman......"

"The Second Young Mrs. Wang ought to conduct herself with more propriety. You are a married woman — behaving in such a manner before my husband will you not worry that the Second Young Mr. Wang might misunderstand, should he learn of it?"

Qin Ruyue had not yet finished speaking when Qin Ruyin walked in, arm in arm with her eldest sister Rujin and their mother, Lady Li.

Rujin, too, cast a cold gaze at Qin Ruyue.

"Second Young Mrs. Wang, what sort of display is this, and for whom? You married into the distinguished Wang family — this kind of behavior belongs in the brothels and pleasure quarters!"

Rujin was genuinely furious.

She had never imagined Qin Ruyue capable of being so utterly shameless.

It truly shook her to the core.

For the sake of her little sister, she — ever measured and gentle by nature — had thrown all restraint aside.

The men present could not rightly confront a woman like Qin Ruyue.

That was correct.

For a full-grown man to argue with a brazen woman like Qin Ruyue would only diminish his own dignity.

Her little sister was newly wed.

With her brother-in-law present, he too should show restraint — his words could not be too harsh.

Their mother was a senior generation — to trade insults with a female junior, even if victorious, was no glory.

But she was different.

She had been married for years.

And she was Qin Ruyue's equal in standing.

This was precisely the moment for her to step up!

The color drained from Qin Ruyue's lovely face inch by inch.

Who was Qin Rujin to dare call her a woman of the brothels?

The Old Matriarch and Tong Shi, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, were both displeased.

Both women surged forward as one to tear into Rujin.

The eyes of Feng Mama, who stood at Qin Ruyin's side, sharpened.

No one save Jiang Jiuxiao saw how Feng Mama acted — but mother-in-law and daughter-in-law ended up tangled together on the floor.

To the onlookers, it appeared as though the two women had lurched forward in the same direction in their haste and collided with each other.

The furious Qin Mingjie and his son scrambled to help their respective mothers to their feet.

Qin Ruyue's eyes had gone red.

"How can Elder Sister speak so cruelly? Is it because you've been without a child for so many years since marrying your husband, that your temperament has grown so sharp and bitter — that you must humiliate and crush even your own kin to feel satisfied?"

She wasn't merely turning the tables — she was driving a blade into Rujin's most tender wound.

The entire First Branch of the Qin family changed expression as one.

Before anyone could speak up for Rujin, someone moved faster.

A clear, crisp slap rang out. Qin Ruyue stared in disbelief at the person now standing before her — Qin Ruyin.

Qin Ruyin's palm burned with pain, reddening even sooner than Qin Ruyue's cheek.

This slap had been delivered with every ounce of her strength.

"Who is your elder sister? The Third Young Mrs. of the Feng family in the capital — she is your elder sister!"

"As for my elder sister — how dare you bully her? I will beat you until you beg for mercy!"

Even Jiang Jiuxiao raised his brows in surprise.

His eyes filled with amusement. So his new bride had this fierce and imperious side to her.

Let alone him — even the First Branch relatives present were stunned.

This girl, always gentle and sweet, had struck someone with all her might — for the sake of her elder sister.

Well struck!

Childlessness after years of marriage was Rujin's deepest wound.

And the wound of the entire Qin First Branch family.

Anyone who dared wound Rujin over this to her face — the whole family would not care a whit for propriety or principle. They would beat what needed beating and curse what needed cursing.

Even if it came to all of them charging in together!

And so, after Qin Ruyin slapped Qin Ruyue, the eldest sister-in-law Lin Xi stepped forward with a cool expression and delivered another slap of her own.

There it was.

Both sides of the face had been struck — a perfect symmetry.

Qin Ruyue clutched her face, her mind a fog.

She could not fathom how the women of the Qin First Branch were all out of their minds.

Not a shred of dignity between them — unable to argue their way through, they simply resorted to violence......

"You...... all of you are outrageous!" Qin Mingjie wheezed with fury, fixing a vicious gaze on the Elder Master.

"Originally, your daughter and her new husband should have come to our residence to bow and pay respects to their grandmother on the return visit after the wedding......"

"Left and right, we waited and no couple came. Our Old Matriarch, kind-hearted as she is, thought to herself that the new son-in-law is, after all, a second-rank official of the court — it was understandable that he would not come to pay respects to us elders. We as elders should not trouble ourselves to withhold our effort, and so we came in person to your residence...... and this is how you receive us?"

The Elder Master regarded him with cold eyes. "If before, I still had some qualms out of deference to my late father, and was reluctant to make a clean break with the Shunyi Hutong branch......"

"Then let me make it clear today, for the benefit of all the Shunyi Hutong branch: from this day forward, the two families are done with each other entirely. All of you — get out!"

The Elder Master had originally intended to restrain himself somewhat, for the new son-in-law's sake.

After all, he didn't know the son-in-law well enough yet.

He worried that if his family behaved too overbearingly, it would damage Ruyin's image in the new son-in-law's eyes.

But since Ruyin had already struck the blow, there was no longer any point in holding back.

If the son-in-law thought less of Ruyin for it, then Ruyin had simply married the wrong person.

He'd wait a few years, until he and his sons had climbed high enough, and then bring Ruyin home from the Jiang family......

So it was that he showed Qin Mingjie no further civility.

Qin Mingjie stared wide-eyed.

When the Second Master had shouted about refusing to recognize the Shunyi Hutong branch, Qin Mingjie had paid it no mind.

But now Qin eldest was actually saying, to Jiang Jiuxiao's face, that the two families were done with each other?

Was he not afraid that the son-in-law would think him cold-blooded and heartless, and from that point on look down upon this First Branch family as in-laws?

"Elder brother, are you in earnest?" Qin Mingjie forced himself to hold his ground, though his eyes already betrayed a flicker of panic.

"Who still jokes with you?" Qin Mingfeng gave a cold snort.

"You people barge into my home and make a racket, and then insult my daughter. Did you take me for a dead man?"

"But your eldest daughter-in-law and your youngest daughter struck my daughter!" Qin Mingjie was incensed. "How do you intend to make restitution?"

"Precisely! Yue'er is our daughter, raised and cradled in the palm of our hand. Neither her father nor I could ever bring ourselves to raise a finger against her......"

"She came to your residence today, only to be struck by your daughter-in-law and your daughter. How do you propose to compensate?"

"Madam Qin, those words are laughable. How is it that you make no mention of what your fine daughter said and did?"

Supported by Feng Mama, Qin Ruyin walked up to stand before Tong Shi.

Tong Shi met Feng Mama's sharp, cutting gaze and recoiled in fright, stumbling backward several steps.

"She is a married woman, and yet she stood openly before my husband in that pitiful, coquettish manner, and said such things — one would think she was deliberately trying to seduce my husband."

Feng Mama spoke up in good time, addressing Qin Ruyin: "Miss, a woman of that sort — our master would not spare her even a passing glance. The only one without dignity here is herself."

The color drained completely from Qin Ruyue's face again.

"You...... you are defaming me!"

"Is that so?" Qin Ruyin looked at her with contempt. "I do wonder very much what expression the Second Young Mr. Wang would make, were he to learn of what you did today."

"You...... don't you dare......" Qin Ruyue broke down in tears. "You've already slapped me — let it end there, I'll count myself unlucky. You...... none of you are to breathe a word of this to anyone! Wuu wuu......"

Qin Ruyue felt utterly wretched.

She was a reborn soul, with every advantage of foresight — every one of these people should have been a defeated enemy beneath her.

And yet...... why did she keep suffering defeat at every turn?

"Lord...... Lord Jiang, I truly had no such intention...... I, I am already married — how could I possibly harbor feelings toward you......"

"Won't you say something on my behalf?"

Jiang Jiuxiao had paid no particular mind to this farce.

He didn't even know what shape Qin Ruyue was — round or flat.

He had only thought that this married woman was no clever person — exceedingly foolish.

He had not considered that this foolish married woman might harbor such indecent thoughts.

But now this foolish woman's mouth was full of "no" and "nothing of the sort," while she continued to pester him — which made him feel genuinely revolted.

He was not going to open his mouth and address this foolish woman.

"Feng Mama! Send someone to the Wang household to invite the Second Young Mr. Wang! If the Second Young Master is unavailable, invite Lady Wang instead!"

Seeing this shameless creature still trying to attract Jiang Jiuxiao's attention, Qin Ruyin's expression darkened immediately.

Feng Mama complied at once.

The Shunyi Hutong Qin family all panicked.

"You mustn't go!" The Old Matriarch was the first to react, and she rounded on Qin Ruyin: "Ruyin, Yue'er is newly wed — are you not deliberately trying to drive a wedge between her and her husband?"

Qin Ruyin met the old woman's gaze coldly.

"Madam Qin, please don't apply such a double standard. Dare you say that Qin Ruyue's behavior just now was not a deliberate attempt to drive a wedge between my husband and me?"

"My husband and I are also newly wed! Why should we be subjected to her disgusting behavior?"

Lady Li's anger rose from the bottom of her heart.

She said to Feng Mama: "Feng Mama, go quickly and invite the Wang family. Don't conceal anything — tell them directly......"

"That the Second Young Mrs. of the Wang family said and did things she ought not, here in our residence, and was struck for it by members of our Qin family!"

Feng Mama immediately gave Lady Li a respectful bow. "Madam, rest assured. This old servant will see to it at once!"

chapters.title: Jiang Jiuxiao Intervenes on Behalf of the Qin First Branch
chapters.content:
The Shunyi Hutong Qin family was thrown into a panic.

Qin Ronggong even lunged several steps toward Feng Mama in an attempt to stop her.

Feng Mama shifted with a slight movement of her body, and Qin Ronggong pitched forward and fell flat on his face.

Qin Ronggong grimaced in pain, and Qin Mingjie rushed to help him up.

Tong Shi and the Old Matriarch cried out in distress.

All the while, Qin Ruyue stood clutching her red, swollen cheeks, weeping softly where she stood.

"Let us go...... we are leaving!" Qin Ronggong raged at his father: "We came here in good faith to meet Qin Ruyin's new husband, only to be humiliated like this by their entire family......"

"Father, you must report them at court tomorrow for the crimes of unfilial conduct and fraternal discord!"

This was a threat.

His intent was to use it to frighten the Qin First Branch into backing down.

But all he received in return was a cold reply from the Elder Master: "Very well. This official will be waiting."

Jiang Jiuxiao turned his gaze slowly toward Qin Mingjie: "And this official will likewise wait for Lord Qin to report this official for the crime of unfilial conduct."

Qin Mingjie: "......"

He was not certain whether Jiang Jiuxiao was threatening him.

The Elder Master turned to Jiang Jiuxiao: "My son-in-law, your filial piety is admirable, and your brotherly love is well known to all."

"Our Qin household has separated from the Shunyi Hutong branch. After the split, they are no longer our concern......"

Jiang Jiuxiao gave the Elder Master a reassuring glance. "Father-in-law, do not worry. Even if the Shunyi Hutong branch chose not to raise this matter at court, I would still wish to invite the hundred officials to deliberate on it."

Then he turned once more to Qin Mingjie: "To deliberate on the question of what standing two households that have separated their clans should rightfully hold toward one another."

Now Qin Mingjie understood.

Jiang Jiuxiao was threatening him!

He hastily lowered his head and bowed his hands in greeting: "Lord Jiang, my son behaved without decorum! Even if the two households have separated their clans, we are still blood kin of broken bone — connected by flesh and blood!"

"......It is one thing to quarrel over small matters from time to time, but there is no need to take this to the court!"

And with that, he kicked his eldest son viciously.

He put his full force into it.

Qin Ronggong howled like a slaughtered pig.

That wretched boy!

He had nearly brought ruin upon all of their Shunyi Hutong Qin household......

The Old Matriarch shot Qin Mingjie a reproachful glance, displeased that the kick had been so forceful.

Tong Shi, however, understood the gravity of the situation, and this time did not take her son's side.

If Jiang Jiuxiao truly brought this before the court for deliberation, the Shunyi Hutong Qin family would be left with absolutely no shred of dignity.

They would be pointed at and laughed at everywhere they went......

Qin Ruyue had wept for so long, yet not a single family member had come to offer her a word of comfort. Her heart was a roiling sea of grievance and resentment.

No one cared about her!

That Feng Mama beside Qin Ruyin had already sent someone to the Wang household......

If the Second Young Mr. Wang or his mother really did come, how would she ever face anyone again?

By now, it was clear — this was no place to linger.

Qin Ruyue finally collected herself.

"Grandmother, Father — since Grand-uncle has declared that from this day forward the two families are done with each other...... staying longer will only make us more unwelcome. Let us go back!"

At that moment, the Old Matriarch, who had been fuming, burst out: "It was all you, Yue'er! You were the one who wanted to come, and now you're the one saying we should go!"

"If not for your foolish idea, would we have needed to come here and suffer this humiliation? And you've caused your elder brother to get kicked by your father!"

Thankfully she hadn't grown so muddled in her old age as to have said it loudly. She hissed it all under her breath.

And of the First Branch, only Qin Ruyin, who stood closest, had caught any of it.

Ruyin cast Qin Ruyue a mocking, contemptuous look — the woman's eyes wide with shock and resentment.

She stepped a few paces closer to Qin Ruyue, and in a voice only the two of them could hear, said with scorn: "So it was Second Young Mrs. Wang's idea to come to our residence in the first place?"

"Well then, there's no need to rush off — stay a while and wait for the Wang family to come collect you."

She was deliberately kicking a person when they were down.

Slapping this woman once today had not been nearly enough to satisfy her.

At first, Qin Ruyin had thought — women need not make things hard for other women.

Even if this reborn woman kept stirring up trouble, so long as it remained petty mischief, Ruyin would let it pass.

At most, a few sharp words of warning.

Or let this reborn woman suffer a small setback and leave it at that.

But she couldn't understand why this reborn woman — already married into the Wang family — still refused to behave.

Well then. She couldn't be blamed.

She herself had always believed in reciprocity.

She would not suffer the smallest injustice.

Especially when this brain-addled fool had the audacity to openly try to ensnare her husband in public.

That, truly, had left her deeply shaken.

Qin Ruyin deliberately stalled so Qin Ruyue could not slip away.

Jiang Jiuxiao perceived his new bride's intentions.

So he took the initiative to ask Qin Mingjie several questions about a matter of official business.

Qin Mingjie was overjoyed.

All the previous humiliations seemed as though they had never occurred.

He launched into a verbose, embellished account of how brilliantly he had handled one assignment or another......

The Old Matriarch was also pleasantly surprised.

This Jiang Jiuxiao was, after all, the Minister of Personnel.

If he was truly impartial, and her son's work truly had been done so well, the Minister ought to award him an outstanding rating — ought he not?

And so she forgot entirely about leaving.

Tong Shi had perceived the situation with some clarity, yet she, too, clung to a thread of hope.

What if Jiang Jiuxiao, as Minister of Personnel, truly valued ability over personal feeling, and genuinely recognized Qin Mingjie's capabilities?

If Qin Mingjie advanced in rank, it would benefit not only her sons, but herself as his official wife as well.

At the very least, her honorific title would rise along with his.

She was growing old.

Even if she still despised Qin Mingjie...... it would no longer be worth going through the procedures of separation over something like this.

Besides, Qin Mingjie's failings were limited to matters of the bedroom. Separating from him over such things was not worth the cost.

And so, knowing that the longer they waited the greater the chance the Wang family might actually arrive, she still chose to say nothing.

Only Qin Ruyue was consumed with anxiety.

And then, amid her suffering, a page announced from outside the door:

Lady Wang of the Wang household had come to pay a call.

The color drained entirely from Qin Ruyue......

She stared in horror at the door.

"Please invite Lady Wang to the side hall for a conversation." Lady Li spoke.

Then she took her daughters-in-law and daughters and went to the adjacent side hall.

The Old Matriarch and Tong Shi exchanged a glance.

Lady Wang was Qin Ruyue's own mother-in-law.

Since they were all present, they could hardly fail to see her.

"Yue'er, let us go and greet your mother-in-law." Tong Shi came to Qin Ruyue's side and spoke quietly.

"Mother! My face is in this state — how am I to face my mother-in-law? And if she asks how it happened, what do we say?"

Qin Ruyue had absolutely no desire to face Lady Wang — her mother-in-law.

That old crone looked down on her.

On the surface, she treated her with the same warmth as her eldest daughter-in-law. But in private, she pricked her with pointed words at every turn, diminishing her, belittling her......

And now she was about to learn that her daughter-in-law had been slapped in the Qin household. Who knew how many cutting, gloating words were waiting for her?

"Not knowing how to explain it is no excuse for not going! You are already someone else's daughter-in-law. Your mother-in-law is in the prime of her years and her strength — you've decades ahead of you yet, living under her roof......"

"If you don't go to greet her today and she finds out, you won't escape the charge of being unfilial. Your husband will think less of you as well. Will that not make things even worse?"

"Come with your mother and go pay your respects to your mother-in-law!" Tong Shi reached out to pull Qin Ruyue along.

Qin Ruyue let out another grieving sob of tears.

By the time Tong Shi had dragged Qin Ruyue into the side hall, everyone had already exchanged greetings and taken their seats.

"Oh my goodness — Yue'er? Is that you, Yue'er? Your face...... how did your face end up like this?"

Lady Wang saw Qin Ruyue's face and rose to her feet in shock, teacup still in hand.
